sub_problems.fills: standing teeth that read the standing seals rather than re-run the proofs
sub_problems.what: each standing tooth asks validation_store.standing() over its named proofs and reds a red seal or a stale fingerprint; budgets 300 s and 600 s
sub_problems.why: re-running three slow proofs inside one tooth outruns any budget and re-derives settled answers (Law 1); the seals already record what those proofs measured
